in_marathi.name: Elvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Elvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Elvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Elvi' meaning Goddess and 'Ka' meaning Grace. It represents the goddess of grace and beauty, and is often associated with the light of the moon.
